prompt: Set me up an agentic engineering workflow in Claude Code with tool-locked roles and hard gates so the agents build but I stay in the merge seat. Implementer physically cannot touch tests or specs, reviewer can only read, each role pinned to a sensible model tier. Scaffold the template and create the role subagents. Self-approve checkpoints, stop once the five role subagents exist.

assertions.text: Directory tree present (.claude/{agents,skills,hooks}, specs, src, tests, plans, docs/tdd-evidence, secrets)
A baseline test file exists under tests/
CLAUDE.md exists and states the founder is the only one who may merge
CLAUDE.md states specs are frozen during implementation / drift-to-issue
All five role subagent files exist (triage, spec-author, test-author, implementer, reviewer)
Reviewer subagent has no Edit/Write in its tools
Models pinned per roster (triage=haiku, spec=opus, test/impl/review=sonnet)
Implementer, spec-author, and test-author carry PreToolUse frontmatter path guards
Path guards cover Write() not only Edit() — no guard leak
gh repo create / branch-protection prepared but NOT executed (no real remote)
Stopped at Phase 2 — no Phase-3 hook wiring written
